scope: Source metadata and author-repository README only; no dataset-file, historical-market, model-weight, private-account or order download.

dataset.title: An Open Book: Level 4 Order Book Data from the Hyperliquid Exchange
dataset.licence: Zenodo HTML exposed a rights heading without a readable license value in this access; author-repository README says source data retain their own license. Confirm primary license before use.
dataset.whole_archive_size: About 121.6 GB plus the 10.2 MB map archive, before extraction and outputs; publisher rounded decimal sizes. A subset may suffice for other questions, but no random-access/streaming plan was verified.
dataset.checksum_scope: Publisher-displayed MD5 only; none verified locally because no file was obtained.
dataset.schema_page_access: Web provider reported inaccessible; no alternate route attempted.

author_reconstruction.read_scope: README only, moving default branch; exact commit and code not audited.
author_reconstruction.observed_limits: Public book diffs omit consensus block number, block timestamp and oracle stream. The author describes conservative availableTime reconstruction from other streams and synthetic replay counters; these are not original chain block identifiers. The July 2026 raw node archive and derived panels are not supplied by this repository.
author_reconstruction.licence_scope: Repository README says MIT applies to code only, not to the underlying data.

local_storage.scope: One instantaneous local measurement; not a permanent capacity guarantee.

decision: Do not fetch the large archives without explicit owner authorization and a feasible bounded resource plan. Even with the archives, public reconstructed times are not observed local first-seen CEX/Hyperliquid feed and order-arrival/cancel/fill clocks.
